description: What the flow did: the plan digest, pass or fail per step, whether cardid was unchanged, and the boot check. No device value.

backup.description: Backup evidence: verified, owner-only, outside the repository. Never a file name or a directory stem. A dry run reports `verified: false`, because nothing was read back.

full_backup.description: The whole 8 MB backup, or `null` when none was asked for: `taken`, `verified` (two reads and the stored file agreed), `owner_only`, `inside_repository` and `bytes`. Never a file name, a directory stem or a digest.

rehearsal.description: The same for the emulator rehearsal.

steps.description: The steps that ran, in order, each pass or fail.
